name: Neo Grid Bold
description: Editorial neo-brutalist presentation master with off-white paper, black ink blocks, and a single neon-yellow accent for punchy student reports and design-led defenses.

source.source_slide_count_note: template.json says 13, but the copied template.html contains 12 deck-stage sections; generated assets follow the HTML source.

font_strategy.cjk_fallback: Microsoft YaHei or Noto Sans SC

readability_scale.target: classroom projection readable at approximately 3 meters

render_strategy.notes: Rendered through the deck-stage API. Navigation chrome is hidden before screenshot capture. Text box outlines are rewritten to DrawingML noFill for LibreOffice and WPS compatibility.

rescue_notes: Rebuilt as an HTML-background hybrid master following the corrected noFill text-box standard. Frontend and Writer consume visual_master=neo_grid_bold.
